title: 第5章 金色玄气神秘大礼第6章 第一份大礼 上古神器天地洪炉
content_zh:
“今日所有人给我的嘲讽和挖苦，将会变成深深的恐惧和极度的敬畏！”
“紫玲珑，当年的我曾经是你追赶的目标，如今你却高高在上，如同九天凤凰！”
“以后的我，将会让你崇拜、仰望，我会让你知道，什么才是绝世天骄！”
林玄的住处，位于外门边缘的杂役区。
其实就是一座漏风的石屋，茅草铺垫的石床，只够他一人居住。
回到住处后，他关闭房门，在石床上闭目盘坐。
“丹田和经脉已经恢复，现在的我，最需要的就是提升境界！”
武者修炼，需要服用丹药。
而林玄积攒的丹药，早在他受伤之后就被别人抢光了。
没有丹药，只能先尝试苦修。
按照鸿蒙大帝的交代，《鸿蒙帝经》设有传承禁制，达到第一个武道境界时才能开启。
也就是说，他要先达到玄气境一层才行。
这个限制让他感到奇怪，他已经是鸿蒙帝经的传人，为何还要受此约束？
原因不得而知，也许帝经开启的那一刻，才能真正明白。
眼下，他只能用最基本的方法进行修炼。
稍作尝试，他便呆了！
最简单的一次呼吸吐纳，都有大量的灵气进入体内，比他鼎盛时期十几次还多。
考虑到境界的差别，修炼效率比同阶武者至少高出几十倍。
帝气对肉身的改造，恐怖如斯！
在玄气境这个层次，武者的修炼相对简单。

借助呼吸吐纳，引天地灵气入体，于气海之中转化为精纯玄气，聚天瀑飞溪，过灵桥栈道，下注丹田；
再借丹田之力推动玄气游走周天，滋血脉、壮筋骨，淬肉身、炼体质，蕴神魂、养道府；
灵达臻至，化生玄力！
道经有云：
合抱之木，生于毫末；
九层之台，起于累土。
修炼一途，
以血肉之躯，向天地求道；
借乾坤之气，修渡世宝伐；
积点滴之功，成天地伟力；
超凡尘之外，离太始之虚！
“鸿蒙帝气的改造果然有脱胎换骨之效，让我的天赋、资质彻底蜕变，可惜外门这边灵气稀薄，就算吸干四周的天地灵气，怕也难以进阶！”
content_en:
"The ridicule and sarcasm everyone gave me today will turn into deep fear and extreme awe!"
"Zi Linglong, I used to be the target of your pursuit back then, but now you are so high above me, like a phoenix in the sky!"
"In the future, I will make you worship and look up to me. I will let you know what a peerless genius is!"
Lin Xuan's residence is located in the handyman area on the edge of the outer gate.
In fact, it was a drafty stone house with a thatched stone bed, just enough for him to live alone.
After returning to his residence, he closed the door and sat cross-legged on the stone bed with his eyes closed.
"The dantian and meridians have been restored. What I need most now is to improve my state!"
To practice as a warrior, you need to take pills.
Lin Xuan's accumulation of pills had been snatched away by others long after he was injured.
There is no elixir, so I can only try hard practice first.
According to Emperor Hongmeng's instructions, the "Hongmeng Emperor Sutra" has inheritance restrictions, which can only be opened when reaching the first martial arts realm.
In other words, he must first reach the first level of Xuanqi Realm.
This restriction made him feel strange. He was already the successor of the Hongmeng Emperor Scripture, so why should he still be subject to this restriction?
The reason is unknown. Perhaps we can only truly understand it when the Emperor Sutra is opened.
At the moment, he can only practice using the most basic methods.
After a brief try, he was stunned!
Even with the simplest breath, a large amount of spiritual energy enters the body, more than a dozen times in his prime.
Taking into account the difference in realm, the cultivation efficiency is at least dozens of times higher than that of warriors of the same level.
The transformation of the physical body by the imperial energy is so terrifying!
At the level of the Xuanqi realm, a warrior's training is relatively simple.
With the help of breathing, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth is introduced into the body, and transformed into pure profound energy in the sea of qi. It gathers in the sky, waterfalls and streams, crosses the Lingqiao plank road, and pours into the Dantian;
Then use the power of the Dantian to push the mysterious energy to travel around the sky, nourish the blood vessels, strengthen the muscles and bones, temper the body, refine the physique, accumulate the soul, and nourish the Taoist palace;
Reaching the highest level of spirituality, transforming into profound energy!
The Taoist Scriptures say:
The tree that hugs each other is born at the end of the hair;
The nine-story platform starts from tired soil.
A journey of cultivation,
With flesh and blood, seek truth from heaven and earth;
Borrow the energy of the universe to cultivate the treasure of crossing the world;
Accumulate a little bit of effort and become a powerful force in the world;
Beyond the mundane world, far away from the emptiness of Taishi!
"The transformation of Hongmeng Emperor Qi has indeed had the effect of completely transforming my talents and qualifications. Unfortunately, the spiritual energy here in the outer sect is thin. Even if the spiritual energy of the surrounding world is sucked out, I am afraid it will be difficult to advance!"
